panel_content.A: Complete regulator requirement unit with heading and adjacent qualification, followed by every substantive vendor unit returned by the frozen first nonempty pairing tier in document/page/source order.
panel_content.B: Complete reviewer comment and attached disposition unit with its parent heading; no vendor unit unless the frozen target question explicitly requires that source role.
panel_content.C: Complete reviewer action/comment unit with attached disposition, followed by every vendor counterpart unit returned by the first nonempty frozen pairing tier, in document/page/source order. A vendor-anchored lead uses the same reviewer-then-vendor presentation order.

context_and_provenance: Include exact original-PDF-verified text, document ID and role, content SHA-256, physical PDF page, source span, parent heading, and explicit continuation or qualification. No paraphrase or unrecorded normalization enters evidence text.
deduplication: A source unit with the same document hash and exact source span appears once; preserve the union of lead and pairing references in metadata.
ordering: Regulator, reviewer, vendor role order when present; within a role use document ID, physical page, then source-span start. Panel-specific presentation order above governs the actual packet.
overflow: If any required source unit or the complete packet exceeds the already frozen case-formation bound of two physical pages per unit, 3000 words per unit, 20 counterpart paragraphs, or 3000 counterpart words, mark PACKET_OVERFLOW. No selective truncation, reranking, or replacement is allowed.
no_pair: Include the anchor source unit and the documented NO_PAIR_UNDER_FROZEN_RULE search status; do not create a positive or negative gold label from the search miss. Human and source-scope sufficiency gates decide eligibility.
canonical_identity: Serialize UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, and source units containing exact text and source refs; SHA-256 of these bytes is model_evidence_packet_hash. Freeze bytes before either human adjudicator sees the packet.
human_model_equality: Both independent humans receive the same semantic packet bytes later supplied to both model configurations. Model-specific chat templates can wrap but cannot change evidence content, order, question, roles, or source references.
source_scope_resolution: When humans cannot decide from the packet, a separate resolver may inspect the complete allowed source record while blind to model outputs. The resolver classifies PACKET_INSUFFICIENT versus SOURCE_INDETERMINATE without revising the frozen packet.
